1.consolidated_definition: Rechoncho, gordo. Se dice de la persona o de la parte del cuerpo redonda y abultada. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Parece que no quiere ser tan chubby como era antes (Blogalaxia, PR, 22-12-06)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Plump, chubby. Said of a person or part of the body that is rounded and bulging. Raw anglicism, relatively infrequent. It seems they don't want to be as chubby as they were before (Blogalaxia, PR, 22-12-06)
